name: Internal One-to-One
description: Manager and employee notes centered on the employee's agenda, support, and commitments.

sections.title: Employee-Led Topics
sections.instruction: Summarize the topics and context raised by the employee.

sections.title: Goals and Progress
sections.instruction: List goals, progress, accomplishments, and observable feedback discussed.

sections.title: Blockers and Support
sections.instruction: List blockers and support requested or offered.

sections.title: Development Topics
sections.instruction: Capture development interests and opportunities explicitly discussed.

sections.title: Decisions and Commitments
sections.instruction: List mutual commitments, owners, and timing when stated.

sections.title: Follow-ups
sections.instruction: List follow-up topics and actions. Exclude content explicitly marked off the shared record.
